hooks.command: python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path','') or d.get('tool_response',{}).get('filePath',''))" | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; r=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -f "$r/scripts/post_edit_checks.py" ] && python "$r/scripts/post_edit_checks.py" "$f" || true; }
